scope: domain-neutral test app; AWS single-app E1 runtime dependency path

attempts.reason: A bundled guest command reached its 120 second timeout while device discovery and PostgreSQL startup were not separately observed.
The mount-root lost+found cause was confirmed and PGDATA was moved to a child directory in the retained checkpoint before the run continued.

supports: The test application requires the configured private PostgreSQL endpoint and the AWS security-group path for readiness and record operations.
An attached EBS volume must be formatted, mounted, and bound to a PostgreSQL data subdirectory for data to survive a state-VM reboot.
doesNotSupport: trusted HTTPS, DNS, or certificate completion
state-VM replacement or state-tier high availability
